scope: Static source-code audit of the JCI 2023 CAF culture-image workflow; separate from the Nature Communications 2026 mouse survival/BLI analysis.

findings.title: Record the biological split unit
findings.observation: The review script partitions pooled feature rows with a stratified 70/30 split. The call supplies no donor, culture, or image grouping key.
findings.next_action: Retain biological_unit_id and image_pair_id, then assess held-out biological units where independent units are available.
findings.limit: This is not proof that related images crossed the split. The missing source tables prevent checking row provenance or estimating held-out performance.

findings.title: Retain exclusions before dropping incomplete rows
findings.observation: The review script contains 7 active dropna calls. It prints some post-filter counts but does not return a row-level exclusion ledger.
findings.next_action: Keep qc_exclusion_reason for each original object and report retained/total counts by biological unit and condition.
findings.limit: No claim is made about the number, balance, or consequences of exclusions in the original experiment.

findings.title: Check nuclear and cytoplasmic object identity
findings.observation: The pairing function uses filename and rounded centroid matches, then Parent_Nuclei, to match nuclear and cytoplasmic features.
findings.next_action: Require exactly one parent match for each object within its image pair and segmentation method; preserve unmatched or ambiguous objects in the QC ledger.
findings.limit: The audit does not establish that any pair was misassigned. That requires the original CellProfiler and VAMPIRE tables.

findings.title: Verify channel-pair identity before segmentation
findings.observation: The supplied CellProfiler pipeline disables metadata extraction and matches image sets by order. It includes both propagation and watershed segmentation branches.
findings.next_action: Store image_pair_id and segmentation method explicitly. Check DAPI/cytoplasm pairs rather than relying only on directory order.
findings.limit: The original images are absent, so this is a preflight requirement for future use, not a measured pairing failure.

findings.title: Separate held-out evaluation from descriptive projections
findings.observation: The script reports held-out X_test performance, separate projections to named cell lines and cultures, and an 'Internal Validation' section drawn from pooled sum_data.
findings.next_action: Label test-set metrics, external-line projections, and pooled-data summaries separately in any future report.
findings.limit: The pooled-data section includes training rows; it is not a second independent validation cohort. No original accuracy is reproduced here.

findings.title: Request source measurements before reproducing prediction
findings.observation: The pinned tree has 9 tracked files and no tabular input, image, or fitted-model file with the inspected data extensions. The review script expects a local input directory.
findings.next_action: Request de-identified image/object features, biological-unit annotations, and the exact analysis environment before claiming reproducibility.
findings.limit: This statement concerns this pinned repository tree only, not all data the authors may hold or publish elsewhere.

minimum_future_metadata.purpose: Link donor/culture/batch provenance and define independent validation groups.
Join the matching nuclear/cytoplasm images and keep all objects from the same pair together.
Retain why an original object was excluded or not successfully paired; blank only for reviewed retained objects.

claims_not_supported: any measured mispairing or data leakage
a relationship between these culture images and the Nature 2026 BLI cohort
